'''''The Kaerlia Queen''''' was a hotel on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Turian]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Luralon Odaay]] liked to stay there and it was the site of his assassination by [[Cabe Maquez|Cabe]].
